request.idea: Leo finds a puddle that shows him yesterday.

bible.title: The Puddle's Missing Snail
bible.narrativeComplexity: a simple cause the reader can follow
bible.userIdea: Leo finds a puddle that shows him yesterday.
bible.premise: On the garden path, Leo finds an unusual puddle. It shows yesterday, including a snail hidden beneath a pot.
bible.hook: A falling leaf appears in the water. Beside Leo, that same leaf already lies still.
bible.goal: Find the snail that disappeared beneath the pot.
bible.centralProblem: Leo cannot find the snail outside the puddle. Ripples hide the clue to its hiding place.
bible.stakes: The snail may still be trapped beneath the pot.
emotionalArc: Leo stops with one foot raised.
He bends closer to follow the snail.
He holds still when the picture breaks.
He lifts the pot with both hands.
He leaves room for the snail to pass.
bible.motif: A moving picture beside things that stay still.
